name: Storm over Riverlands
description: Entity Water's river simulation set into Entity Cloud's High Plains: the clouds, rain shafts, haze and lightning are drawn over the river world, and rain falling where the camera is turns on the river's rain.

entities.$comment: the sky: High Plains; its sky and sun are the world's (the river is drawn into its scene, under its clouds, rain, haze and lightning)
the plains make room under the river map by themselves (its footprint); its sea goes on south of it
the river: Riverlands, 1395 m up on the plains, lit by the sky's sun; the camera starts at its first view
its light under the plains' sky (the sun is the sky's: its direction, whatever this says)
what joins them: rain where the camera is turns on the river's rain
